context: Prospectively reviewed acquisition, post-hoc timing preparation, one-recording descriptive comparison. ALS timing remains UNVERIFIED.

numerical_preparation_policy.offset_removal: Independent full-preparation-interval arithmetic mean per channel, before resampling; offsets not restored
numerical_preparation_policy.target_isolation: Each target is centered/filtered independently; target values or statistics never enter retained inputs or reference
numerical_preparation_policy.preparation_filter: scipy.signal.butter order4 bandpass 0.5-40 Hz at 256 Hz; scipy.signal.sosfiltfilt default odd extension
numerical_preparation_policy.timestamp_policy: Fractional-index interpolation of the separately declared counter-supported timing derivative, not unchanged native times. No waveform alignment or missing-sample filling.
numerical_preparation_policy.comparison_filter: Unchanged common post-prediction order4 0.5-40 Hz zero-phase pass on measured/spline/Zuna branches
numerical_preparation_policy.model_context_policy: Unchanged five-second independent contexts and existing reflected-tail behavior
numerical_preparation_policy.evaluation_mask_policy: Unchanged caller-governed exclusions; no amplitude- or outcome-selected exclusion
numerical_preparation_policy.limitation: Linear endpoint extension and centering mitigate DC-padding artifacts, not all filter transients or model seams; not a live/causal implementation

branch_labels.measured: Measured withheld EEG (comparison target, not clean neural ground truth)
branch_labels.zuna: Model-generated estimate (Zuna; not a new measurement)

policy.nmse: Per-electrode MSE / population variance of that measured target, then mean across every declared electrode; undefined electrode NMSE makes the mean not estimable.
policy.rmse: Square root of pooled squared error, equally weighted over all evaluated samples and electrodes; not mean block RMSE.
policy.spectral: Two-second Hann Welch windows, 50% overlap, constant detrend, density scaling; mean weighted by contributing windows, never joining gaps or blocks.
policy.band_integration: Trapezoidal integration including both declared band endpoints; no inferred aperiodic correction.
policy.condition_contrast: Eyes-closed minus eyes-open alpha band power for each branch; descriptive, not confirmed neural response.

primary_final_filter.filtering_history: Final comparison filter applied to every branch over each whole prepared block (or the legacy continuous preparation span), before diagnostic slicing; measured/interpolated data already had preparation filtering, whereas model output receives the comparison pass.

companion_precomparison.filtering_history: Prepared measured/interpolated data versus raw model output before the final comparison filter; no additional filter is applied by these diagnostics.

limitations: Descriptive analysis of one recording; blocks, channels and windows are not independent participants. No inferential, clinical or population-validity claim.
Measured hidden electrodes are comparison targets, not clean neural ground truth. Reproducing or disagreeing with contamination is not proof of cleaning.
Measured, interpolated and model-generated signals remain distinct. Generated channels are estimates, not extra measured electrodes.
Both endpoints are always reported. Filter history differs across branches; do not select the endpoint or condition that favors the model.
Preparation and zero-phase filtering are offline/noncausal. Independent model contexts can create seams; the spectral summaries retain genuine within-block seams rather than silently excluding them.
Condition labels follow the supplied block metadata, not independent confirmation of eye-state compliance or optical timing.
Missing conditions, inadequate contiguous spectral support or zero target variance produce explicit not-estimable results, never a zero score.

These summaries do not change acquisition purpose, QC evidence, original masks, channel selection, calibration exclusions or protocol eligibility. No automatic blink detector or amplitude-based exclusion is applied.

policy_definition.supported_route: PRAYCG explicit-push-chunk Cyton-Daisy, 125 Hz, package step 2
policy_definition.clock_ambiguity_guard: Reject >= half a 128-sample counter cycle (0.512 s); residual envelope < quarter-cycle (0.256 s). These are counter-ambiguity guards, not timing accuracy claims.
policy_definition.grid: Least-squares sample-index affine fit of native host-receipt timestamps within each independently counter-verified contiguous region; apply only recorded XDF clock offsets.
policy_definition.missing_sample_policy: No insertion, deletion, interpolation of EEG, or gap stitching; anomalous chunks and adjoining boundary are unverified.
policy_definition.selection: All supported evidence-qualified recordings, not a retry selected by failed gates or model outcomes.

timing.limitation: Post-hoc sample-index timing approximation supported by exact diagnostic/XDF count alignment and recorded counters. Counters wrap and are not independently recorded in XDF; host receipt times do not establish physical ADC/display timing or prove zero hardware loss. No waveform fitting, ALS correction, target-informed selection, missing-sample filling, or raw timestamp edits.

model_comparison.primary: mean per-electrode NMSE, prospectively reviewed one-session descriptive

spectrum.estimator: scipy.signal.welch; Hann 2s, 50% overlap, constant detrend; per-contiguous-interval PSDs weighted by complete Welch-window count

condition_comparison.current_display: Use descriptive_diagnostics for the declared Welch-window-weighted condition summary when present; weighting definitions differ.
condition_comparison.inference: One session, not independent participants; no p-value or population inference.

record.interpretation: Prospectively reviewed one-session comparison: Zuna had lower mean normalized error than spherical-spline interpolation (Zuna 1.087064398727744; spline 4.1902426347099055). Four measured electrodes were withheld. Completion does not remove original QC warnings or establish recovery of clean neural activity.
limitations: Experimental within-recording prediction benchmark, not proof of artifact removal, neural origin, diagnosis, thought decoding, or generalizable scientific validity. The recorded held-out signal is a comparison target, not clean ground truth.
Prospectively reviewed montage contract; one-session descriptive benchmark, not population validation.
Actual electrode mapping is an operator declaration, not independent measured proof. Legacy aliases T3/T4/T5/T6 map to T7/T8/P7/P8 template coordinates.
Original calibration is excluded, not repaired. The fixed pretrained model uses retained-only per-window normalization; no fitted calibration or target-informed selection.

Post-hoc sample-index timing approximation supported by exact diagnostic/XDF count alignment and recorded counters. Counters wrap and are not independently recorded in XDF; host receipt times do not establish physical ADC/display timing or prove zero hardware loss. No waveform fitting, ALS correction, target-informed selection, missing-sample filling, or raw timestamp edits.
Each observed block is independently resampled and filtered; no computation crosses an inter-block or acquisition gap. Five seconds at each block edge are excluded.

Versioned offline boundary-safe preparation independently removes each channel block mean before line-padded resampling. This is a new derivative, not historical execution replay or a change to the frozen recipe. It is noncausal and does not eliminate every edge transient or model seam.
All branches receive the same fixed post-prediction 0.5–40Hz filter; measured and spline branches consequently have two filter passes. Unfiltered generated arrays are retained.
Five-second independent model contexts may produce seams; this is a PRAYCG operationalization, not an exact reproduction of the upstream paper.
Condition labels follow software observations; actual acoustic onset and eye-state compliance were not independently measured.
No inferential p-value, clean-brain claim, automatic artifact removal or participant-data promotion is permitted.
RAW_CONTAINER: Timestamp gaps exceed the frozen multiple of the expected sampling interval.
RAW_CONTAINER: At least one measurable 50/60 Hz line ratio exceeds the frozen caution threshold.
PROTOCOL_WINDOW: Timestamp gaps exceed the frozen multiple of the expected sampling interval.
PROTOCOL_WINDOW: At least one measurable 50/60 Hz line ratio exceeds the frozen caution threshold.

Acquisition montage was reviewed prospectively; the counter-supported host-receipt timing derivative is a separately versioned post-hoc processing policy, not prospective validation or physical timing calibration.
